country.name: Botswana
country.jurisdictionNotice: Basic education and child welfare, skills and TVET, qualifications and provider accreditation, and tertiary planning are separate responsibilities. BRASA must preserve the competent authority, record type, location, status and effective date for every claim.
country.languagePolicy: English, Setswana and Botswana's community languages have distinct administrative, instructional and community roles. Translation into Setswana, Kalanga, Shekgalagari, Seyeyi, Herero, San languages or another language is not reviewed localization without the appropriate education and community review.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Botswana reviewer, current authoritative evidence and review by the responsible education, BQA, privacy, child-protection, institution or community authority.

governanceModel.summary: The Ministry of Child Welfare and Basic Education governs child welfare and basic education; district offices support school registration and administration; the authority responsible for skills and TVET governs that subsector; BQA registers and accredits providers, learning programmes and qualifications within its mandate; Statistics Botswana and HRDC publish different education statistics.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve official school name, registration record, district, locality, sector, level, current operating status, source publication date and review date. A legally maintained register and a dated published list are not the same thing.
governanceModel.qualificationRule: Provider registration or accreditation, accreditation of an exact learning programme, registration of a qualification on the NCQF, awarding authority, delivery site or mode, professional recognition and current validity are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of Child Welfare and Basic Education
authorities.role: child welfare, basic education policy, curriculum, inspectorate and education information

authorities.name: District Education Offices
authorities.role: local school-registration assessment, recommendation and administration within assigned competence

authorities.name: Curriculum Development and Evaluation Department
authorities.role: curriculum development and evaluation across designated basic-education levels and modalities

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for skills development and TVET
authorities.role: skills-development and TVET policy and implementation within its current legal mandate

authorities.name: Botswana Qualifications Authority
authorities.role: provider registration and accreditation, programme accreditation, registered qualifications and awarding-body records

authorities.name: Statistics Botswana
authorities.role: official education statistics and education-publication series

authorities.name: Human Resource Development Council
authorities.role: tertiary education planning and statistics within its mandate

authorities.name: Information and Data Protection Commission
authorities.role: data-protection supervision under the Data Protection Act 2024

curriculum.authority: Ministry of Child Welfare and Basic Education through the competent curriculum authority
curriculum.title: Botswana official curriculum, syllabuses and approved guidance
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm the exact level, grade, subject, modality, official syllabus or framework, approving instrument, version, publication date, effective school year and current implementation guidance. A policy strategy, reform announcement or pilot does not by itself prove the controlling current syllabus for every school.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: National curriculum framework, subject syllabus, teacher guide, examination syllabus, textbook, strategy, pilot and external resource are different layers and must not silently replace one another.

schoolDirectory.authority: Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Child Welfare and Basic Education, with District Education Offices within their assigned roles
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: Botswana requires registration of government, government-aided and private schools, and the Permanent Secretary maintains a register. Publicly located discovery files were dated lists for public primary schools and registered private primary and secondary schools, not a verified single current live public directory for every school and level. Preserve each list's publication date and any waiver expiry; never infer current operation from an older entry.
requiredRecordFields: official school name and registration identifier when published

educationStatistics.authority: Statistics Botswana, the basic-education ministry and HRDC within their respective statistical mandates
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must display the observation or academic year separately from its release date, together with subsector, definition, public/private coverage, geography and source. A Primary Education Statistics Brief released in 2026 can describe 2022 data; a 2024 tertiary report can describe academic year 2023/24. Release date must never be presented as the data year.

higherEducationAndTVET.authority: Botswana Qualifications Authority and other competent education, awarding or professional authorities within their mandates
higherEducationAndTVET.authorityNotice: Registration or accreditation of an education and training provider does not prove accreditation of every learning programme or registration of every qualification. Verify the exact provider, programme, qualification, awarding body, level, site or mode, registration or accreditation number, decision, status and expiry or review date. Professional recognition may require separate evidence.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Data Protection Act 2024, Act 18 of 2024, commenced 14 January 2025
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: The 2024 Act repealed the earlier data-protection statute subject to transitional and savings provisions. Controller and processor roles, lawful basis, transparency, minimization, security, retention, learner rights, sensitive or biometric data, images, transfers, child participation, safeguarding and reporting require qualified current review. A proposal or review of the Children's Act is not enacted law until an authoritative enacted text says so.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: English, Setswana and Botswana's community languages have distinct administrative, instructional, curriculum and community roles. San languages, Kalanga, Shekgalagari, Seyeyi, Herero and other languages or varieties must not be treated as interchangeable. Preserve the exact school, level, subject, language or variety, orthography, approved material, accessibility need and community review.

completionCriteria: A qualified Botswana education reviewer is named.
Basic education, district, TVET, BQA, HRDC, institution, privacy and child-protection responsibilities are correctly assigned.
A verified unified current public school-directory source is documented or the directory gap remains visibly disclosed.
Every school record preserves registration evidence, district, sector, level, status, source vintage and review date.
Every statistic separates observation or academic year from release date and preserves definition, coverage and geography.
Curriculum mappings preserve level, grade, subject, modality, controlling document, version and effective school year; strategies and pilots are not treated as controlling syllabuses.
Every tertiary or TVET claim separately verifies provider, programme, qualification, awarding authority, site or mode, decision, status and expiry.
English, Setswana and each community language are represented according to their distinct educational and community context.
Privacy, child-protection, accessibility, safeguarding, low-bandwidth, offline and incident procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
No authorization, accreditation, recognition, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
